payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the proposed method's unique approach to multilingual vision-and-language navigation, highlighting its focus on cross-lingual language representation and environment-agnostic visual representation, which differ from existing methods.

claims.text: The proposed method utilizes visually-aligned multilingual instructions to learn a cross-lingual language representation that captures visual semantics, unlike existing methods that do not focus on this alignment.

The method learns an environment-agnostic visual representation by maximizing similarity between paths from different environments, which is a distinct approach compared to existing methods that consider only single environments.
The CLEAR method improves navigation performance by integrating both cross-lingual language and environment-agnostic visual representations, demonstrating effectiveness over traditional methods.
